ins_headline._comment: Human-maintained. Update once a month when INS publishes the IPC press release (~mid-month, for the prior month). Source: https://insse.ro/cms/ro/tags/comunicat-indicele-preturilor-de-consum — open the latest 'MAI/IUNIE… 20xx' PDF and copy the figures below. This is the recognizable NATIONAL IPC headline; the automated chart/nowcast uses Eurostat HICP (see fetch_official_cpi.py).

caveat: Date insuficiente pentru un indice robust — 169 zile disponibile. Valorile vor deveni semnificative după acumularea a cel puțin 4 săptămâni de date.
